find.match_belief: My main passion for music is sharing catharsis and resonating with the audience through live shows. Besides, I also enjoy blending or exploring different genres and sounds in my music.

profile.belief: The technical aspect of making films. The Odyssey right now has me geeking. I need to see the new IMAX cameras in person and I would die if I got to see the blimp. Although The Odyssey is an amazing story, literal epic, I am more excited and engaged at all the technical advancements they have made for this film. That and I just love how shots alone can say so much within a story without ever stating a single word.
profile.working_on: I would love to be a cinematographer. Genuinely my life would be complete if I could just do that for the rest of my life. But I also love producing, working on the legal and business affairs of it all because negotiating is unfortunately too much fun. But like Guillermo and Autumn, I want someone like me and someone with a similar name to be on the big screen at the end of the credits.
